name: Zumpo/Turn bar
description: Sits above the canvas in Draw & Guess and carries the turn: the game’s category (always shown, nested Tag), what to do, the word or the hint, and the phase clock. Word: the drawer sees the word. Hint: guessers see the server’s hint string as is (“__r___”, spaces kept for two-word answers), tracked out 30% so each blank reads as a slot; the server reveals letters at a third and two thirds of the drawing clock, up to a third of the word. Status: choosing, review, waiting. Replaces putting the word or hint in a page Notice. Phone layout: the clock moves up beside the category, and the answer wraps under the label. Category, Countdown, Top row: off when the game has no category (a game on your own), nothing is timed, or (Phone) neither shows. Layout=Phone stacks the label and main line over the tag and meta, which wrap on a line of their own; Layout=Phone row keeps them on one row, for Gomoku on a phone and any window 800 px tall or less.
